title: Industrial Construction Tools Shovel Wood Oval 01
description:
Ready to build something raw and real? The ‘Construction Site’ themed assets are here to provide the perfect foundation for your next project. 

We've captured every detail of an active construction site, from the rough textures of exposed bricks and piles of concrete to the numerous tools and materials that tell a story of work in progress.

See the construction site themed assets in action! This quick-start tutorial shows you exactly how to create a stunning, realistic scene with them.
